lines.zh: 我沿着海边走，练练步法。
lines.en: I walk the shoreline to drill my footwork.
The sun bakes my bald head.
A master's steps should be light.
I just finished polishing a stone.
Two steps, then change my breath.

lines.zh: 海风把我的腰带吹起来。
lines.en: Sea wind lifts my belt.

lines.zh: 我绕着训练场走第三圈。
lines.en: Third lap around the training ground.
Toes grip the ground; that keeps me up.
I go slowly, minding old wounds.

lines.zh: 岛上就我们几个，很安静。
lines.en: Only a few of us on the island. Quiet.
I count my paces: one, two, one, two.
Walk with ki, do not forget.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下很浅的脚印。
lines.en: My footprints barely press the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬手跟远处的鸟打个招呼。
lines.en: I wave at a distant bird.
I sit and wipe down my gloves.
Masters get tired too. Do not tell.

lines.zh: 我在想下一个招式怎么教。
lines.en: Thinking how to teach the next move.

lines.zh: 海面很平，今天适合练气。
lines.en: Calm sea. Good day for ki work.

lines.zh: 我摸摸光头，什么也没有。
lines.en: I rub my head. Nothing there.
Nothing beats sun on the rooftop.

lines.zh: 我把气沉到肚子里，慢慢吐。
lines.en: I sink my ki low and exhale slowly.

lines.zh: 这座岛我熟得闭眼能走。
lines.en: I could cross this island blindfolded.
I count the tide out and in.

lines.zh: 旧伤阴天会痒，习惯就好。
lines.en: Old wounds itch in damp weather. Fine.

lines.zh: 我在等学生自己发现问题。
lines.en: I wait for students to spot it themselves.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，能听见自己心跳。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear my own pulse.

lines.zh: 我盘腿坐着，背挺得很直。
lines.en: Cross-legged, my back held straight.
No fighting today. Only breathing.
Here? Warm up first. No slacking.

lines.zh: 看你这样子，昨晚没睡好吧。
lines.en: You look like you slept badly.

lines.zh: 我是克林，这座岛上的师父。
lines.en: I am Krillin, master of this island.

lines.zh: 站到那边去，我看看你的架势。
lines.en: Stand over there. Show me your stance.
Your ki is steadier than last time.
No big moves yet. Plant your feet.

lines.zh: 徒弟太多，我记性不太够。
lines.en: Too many students. My memory falters.
I hold nothing back, if you train.
That move took me ten years.
You are hurt. Heal first.

lines.zh: 别盯着我光头看，听我说。
lines.en: Stop staring at my head and listen.
Want strength? Come every day.

lines.zh: 我教过很多比你更差的人。
lines.en: I have taught far worse than you.

lines.zh: 站好了，我给你演示一遍。
lines.en: Stand ready. I will show you once.

lines.zh: 气要从脚底起来，不是肩膀。
lines.en: Ki rises from your feet, not shoulders.
What are you laughing at? I am serious.
Ouch — even a master takes hits.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一酸，眼泪差点出来。
lines.en: My nose stings; tears nearly come.
Even masters get hit.

lines.zh: 我揉揉肩膀，重新摆好架势。
lines.en: I rub my shoulder and reset my stance.
Too heavy. You overtrained.
I need salve for this.
Do not grin. I just did not block.
I rub my side and smile.
Another hit on the nose; that really hurts.
No one here to bandage me.
Food? After training.
Simple food here. Do not complain.
Split that bun with me.

lines.zh: 吃饱了容易犯困，少吃点。
lines.en: Full bellies get sleepy. Eat less.
I smell it. Fresh from the steamer.
Ki training means enduring hunger.
Thanks. I skipped breakfast.
Leave it. Not on the training ground.
You cook better than I do.
Eat, then one more set.
Hey, you bumped me. Watch it.
At my height, you hit my waist.
No crowding. The yard is wide.

lines.zh: 碰一下没事，站稳了再走。
lines.en: Fine. Steady yourself, then move.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，撞得我退了。
lines.en: Strong shove. I gave a step.
I plant my hand and catch you.
Walking is training. Do not collide.
You nearly stepped on my toes.
Too close. Half a step back.

lines.zh: 碰撞也是接触，学学重心。
lines.en: A bump is contact. Study your balance.

lines.zh: 这问题，我妻子听了会笑。
lines.en: My wife would laugh at that question.
Housework tires me more than training.
Quiet island life suits me fine.
Do not pry into a master's business.
I wear a ring. Look closely.

lines.zh: 徒弟问我这个，太失礼了。
lines.en: A student asking that is rude.
Master the fist, then the rest.
I chased someone too, once.
Now I just want to keep this island.

lines.zh: 你该去练功，不是问这个。
lines.en: Go train. Not this.
A stone fell. I scoop it up.
My stone. Three years of polishing.
These gloves need replacing. Keep them.
Broken tile on the ground. Sweep it up.
You dropped your bracer. Here.
I bend fast. No help needed.
This bean might be a senzu.
Pick it up and back on the rack.
Loose gear trips students.
I can carry three stones at once.
Come. Spar with me.
Take your stance. I am moving.
I watch your shoulder, not my feet.
This is a lesson. Not a real fight.

lines.zh: 拳套戴好，我等你第一下。
lines.en: Gloves on; I'm waiting for your first move.
Low center. Good.
Gather ki in your fist. Do not scatter.
I count three, then we begin.
Do not fear pain. Fear repeating.
Good. Show me the real thing.
Your footwork scatters. Gather it.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，你就空门大开。
lines.en: I circle, and your side opens.

lines.zh: 眼睛跟着手，不是跟着我。
lines.en: Eyes follow the hand, not me.
Your breathing breaks. Stop.
Before my hit, my ki stirs.
Too eager. That is an opening too.
Watch your feet, not the clouds.

lines.zh: 我这一招还在等你反应。
lines.en: This move waits for your answer.
Again. Do not shut your eyes.
You improve faster than I expected.
This punch is at thirty percent.
A jab of my elbow and you step off.
Take it. Fundamentals.
Caught your shoulder. Light one.
I pause just before impact.
Turn, punch, drive it from the hips.
This one teaches defense.
It hurts because it landed.
Stand. Take the second.
Good. You blocked it.
The yard is open. Come in.

lines.zh: 我在这儿，等下一个徒弟。
lines.en: I am here for the next student.
The sea breeze wakes me.
Someone arrived. I stand.
Gloves on. Training starts.
The island got a little livelier.
I am never late. Today either.
I step out of the hut.
A stone lands; I look up.
Who comes? Name first.

lines.zh: 眉毛烧没了，本来也没有。
lines.en: My brows are singed. Had none anyway.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下来，屁股先着地。
lines.en: Off the roof, landing on my backside.

lines.zh: 海水灌进鼻子，呛得厉害。
lines.en: Seawater up my nose. Choking.
A ki blast bursts at my feet.
A rock chip hits my forehead.
Magic binds my wrists.
One skipped meal and my ki fades.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我头发都立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my hair stands up.
The ground gives; I grab the cliff.
